title: Super Detective Usami-Chan
overview: A major mystery hits Animal Elementary! Sarutaro-kun’s gym uniform has been stolen! But there’s no way Kumakichi-kun would steal a boy’s uniform...So who’s the real culprit!? Could this be the first-ever case where Kumakichi-kun isn't guilty!?

title: The Bremen Town Musicians
overview: A famous German folktale gets the Gag Manga Biyori twist! A rooster, cat, dog, horse, and...a chupacabra(?!), team up to drive out a thief! Even with the surprise cryptid, the gang decides to work together...Wait, stop sucking blood!

title: The Narrow Road to Oku Episode 2: Departure / Lost on the Narrow Road
overview: Two episodes from the Narrow Road to Oku arc! First up, Basho sets off on his journey. Later, deep in the forest, Sora-kun ditches him right after saying, “If you’re scared, just write some haiku.” Now lost and uninspired, Basho faces something worse—a sudden attack from a masked weirdo!?

title: Mahjong
overview: Tonight, men gather ‘round the table...The underworld's strongest face off in the world of Mahjong! There’s just one problem...None of them know the rules!! A legendary fan-favorite finally animated! “Hey pal, you're totally see-through!”

title: The Beam From Taishi's Forehead
overview: One day, Shotoku Taishi won’t stop poking his forehead. Why? Some legend he doesn’t remember says it used to glow. He turns to a fairy-tale forest owl for help, but gets lost in the woods with Imoko, who just wants him back at work! Can Taishi shine with holy dignity at last!?
